recipes.name: Saffron seafood paella with charred lemon

ingredients.name: mussels, cleaned (discard any open ones that don't close when tapped)

method: Soak the saffron in the hot stock. Dice the onion and pepper; slice the garlic.
Heat the oil in a wide pan and soften the onion and pepper for 6 minutes. Add the garlic and paprika for 1 minute, then stir in the rice to coat.
Pour in the saffron stock, stir once, then simmer without stirring for 15 minutes.
Push the prawns, mussels and squid into the rice, scatter over the peas, cover and cook for 6-8 minutes until the mussels open and the prawns are pink. Discard any mussels that stay closed.
Meanwhile, halve the lemons and char them cut-side down in a dry pan. Serve the paella with the charred lemon and chopped parsley.
recipes.tagline: Golden saffron rice with seafood and charred lemon. A weekend showstopper.

recipes.name: Salmon en croûte with lemon-dill sauce
method: Heat the oven to 200C (180C fan). Wilt the spinach, squeeze out the water and mix with the soft cheese, lemon zest and half the chopped dill.
Unroll the pastry, lay the salmon in the middle, top with the spinach mix and fold the pastry over to make a parcel. Seal, glaze with egg and score the top.
Bake for 30-35 minutes until golden. Boil the potatoes alongside for 15-20 minutes.
Mix the crème fraîche with the lemon juice and remaining dill.
Slice the salmon en croûte and serve with the potatoes and lemon-dill sauce.
recipes.tagline: Flaky pastry wrapped round salmon and spinach, with a lemony sauce.

recipes.name: Aubergine parmigiana with basil and burrata
method: Heat the oven to 200C (180C fan). Slice the aubergines lengthways, brush with oil and roast or griddle for 15-20 minutes until soft and golden.
Simmer the tomatoes with the sliced garlic and half the basil for 15 minutes until thick. Season.
Layer the aubergine, sauce and grated cheese in a dish, finishing with sauce and cheese.
Bake for 20 minutes until bubbling.
Tear the burrata over the top, scatter with the remaining basil and serve with rocket.
notes: Uses vegetarian hard cheese instead of parmesan, so it's suitable for vegetarians.
recipes.tagline: Layers of soft aubergine, rich tomato and creamy burrata.

recipes.name: Steak tagliata with rocket, parmesan and balsamic
method: Bring the steak to room temperature, rub with a little oil, rosemary and seasoning.
Sear in a very hot pan for 2-3 minutes each side for medium-rare. Rest for 5 minutes.
Toss the rocket and halved tomatoes with the remaining oil.
Slice the steak thinly, lay over the salad and finish with shaved cheese and balsamic.
recipes.tagline: Seared steak sliced over peppery rocket with parmesan and balsamic.

recipes.name: Crispy-skin sea bass with fennel and orange salad
method: Shave the fennel very thinly. Peel and slice the orange, catching the juice.
Toss the fennel, orange, rocket and olives with the orange juice, vinegar and half the oil.
Pat the fish skin dry and season. Fry skin-side down in the remaining oil over a medium-high heat for 3-4 minutes, pressing gently so the skin stays flat, until crisp.
Turn and cook for 1 minute more. Serve on the salad, skin-side up.
recipes.tagline: Crispy-skinned sea bass with a fresh fennel and orange salad.

recipes.name: Gochujang glazed short ribs with sesame slaw
method: Heat the oven to 160C (140C fan). Brown the ribs all over in a casserole dish.
Mix the gochujang, soy, honey, garlic and ginger. Coat the ribs, add the stock, cover and cook for 2.5-3 hours until very tender.
Lift out the ribs, skim the fat and reduce the sauce until sticky. Return the ribs and coat in the glaze.
Shred the cabbage and carrots and toss with the sesame oil, vinegar and sesame seeds.
Serve the ribs with rice and the slaw.
recipes.tagline: Sticky, spicy, melt-in-the-mouth ribs with a crunchy sesame slaw.

recipes.name: Shakshuka with feta and fresh herbs
method: Soften the sliced onion and pepper in the oil for 8 minutes. Add the garlic and spices for 1 minute.
Add the tomatoes and simmer for 8 minutes until thick. Season.
Make four hollows in the sauce, crack in the eggs, cover and cook gently for 5-7 minutes until the whites are set.
Crumble over the feta and herbs and serve with bread.
recipes.tagline: Eggs baked in a spiced tomato and pepper sauce, finished with feta.

recipes.name: Thai green chicken curry with jasmine rice
method: Rinse the rice and cook in 600ml water, covered, for 12 minutes. Rest for 5 minutes.
Fry the curry paste in the oil for 1 minute. Add the sliced chicken and cook for 5 minutes.
Pour in the coconut milk and stock and simmer for 10 minutes.
Add the beans and sliced courgette for 5 minutes. Season with fish sauce and lime juice.
Serve with the rice and fresh herbs.
recipes.tagline: Fragrant, creamy Thai green curry with tender chicken.

recipes.name: Korean bibimbap with gochujang vegetables and egg
method: Cook the rice for 12 minutes, then rest covered.
Cut the carrot and courgette into matchsticks. Stir-fry each vegetable separately in a little oil for 2-3 minutes, seasoning each with a dash of soy sauce.
Mix the gochujang with the sesame oil and 1 tbsp water.
Fry the eggs until the whites are set and the yolks runny.
Divide the rice between bowls, arrange the vegetables on top, add the egg and finish with the sauce and sesame seeds.
recipes.tagline: A colourful rice bowl with spicy veg and a fried egg on top.

recipes.name: Jerk chicken with pineapple salsa and coconut rice
method: Rub the chicken with the jerk seasoning, oil and half the lime juice. Leave for 15 minutes, or overnight in the fridge.
Heat the oven to 200C (180C fan). Roast the chicken for 35 minutes until cooked through and charred.
Rinse the rice. Simmer with the coconut milk, 200ml water and a pinch of salt, covered, for 12 minutes. Rest for 5 minutes.
Dice the pineapple, red onion and chilli, then mix with the coriander and remaining lime juice.
Serve the chicken with the coconut rice and pineapple salsa.
recipes.tagline: Spicy jerk chicken, sweet pineapple salsa and coconut rice.

recipes.name: Persian pomegranate chicken with saffron rice
method: Soak the saffron in 2 tbsp hot water.
Brown the chicken in the oil, then remove. Soften the sliced onion for 6 minutes, then add the cinnamon and turmeric.
Return the chicken with the molasses, honey and stock. Simmer for 25 minutes until sticky and tender.
Cook the rice for 12 minutes, then stir through the saffron water.
Serve the chicken on the rice, scattered with walnuts and pomegranate seeds.
recipes.tagline: Sweet and sour pomegranate chicken with golden saffron rice.

recipes.name: Moroccan lamb tagine with apricots and almonds

ingredients.name: ras el hanout or mixed Moroccan spice

method: Brown the lamb in batches in the oil, then remove.
Soften the chopped onions for 8 minutes, then add the garlic and spices for 1 minute.
Return the lamb with the tomatoes, stock and apricots. Cover and simmer gently for 1.5 hours.
Add the drained chickpeas and cook uncovered for 20 minutes more until the lamb is tender.
Pour 300ml boiling water over the couscous and cover for 5 minutes. Serve the tagine on the couscous with almonds and coriander.
recipes.tagline: Slow-cooked spiced lamb with sweet apricots and toasted almonds.

recipes.name: Goan coconut fish curry

ingredients.name: firm white fish fillets (such as cod or pollock)

method: Soften the chopped onion in the oil for 6 minutes. Add the garlic, ginger, chilli and spices for 1 minute.
Add the tomatoes and coconut milk and simmer for 10 minutes.
Cut the fish into chunks, add to the sauce and poach gently for 5-6 minutes until just cooked.
Cook the rice for 12 minutes. Finish the curry with lime juice and coriander and serve with the rice.
recipes.tagline: Mild, creamy coconut fish curry with a gentle warmth.

recipes.name: Crispy chilli beef with sesame greens
method: Cook the rice. Slice the beef into thin strips and toss in the cornflour with a pinch of salt.
Fry the beef in hot oil in batches until crisp, then drain on kitchen paper.
Stir-fry the sliced pepper, carrot, garlic and chilli for 3 minutes.
Add the sweet chilli sauce, soy sauce and vinegar, bubble briefly, then toss the beef back through.
Stir-fry the greens with the sesame oil for 2 minutes. Serve everything with the rice and sesame seeds.
recipes.tagline: Crispy strips of beef in a sweet chilli glaze.

recipes.name: Tandoori salmon with mint yoghurt
method: Heat the oven to 220C (200C fan). Mix 1 tbsp yoghurt with the tandoori spice and half the lemon juice. Coat the salmon.
Roast for 12-15 minutes until just cooked. Cook the rice alongside.
Mix the remaining yoghurt with chopped mint, grated cucumber and a squeeze of lemon.
Serve the salmon on the rice with lettuce and the mint yoghurt.
recipes.tagline: Spiced, charred salmon with cool mint yoghurt.

recipes.name: Chicken shawarma bowls with garlic sauce
method: Toss the chicken with the spices, half the lemon juice, 1 crushed garlic clove and the oil. Leave for 10 minutes.
Cook the chicken under a hot grill or in a griddle pan for 6-7 minutes each side until charred and cooked through. Rest, then slice.
Mix the yoghurt with the remaining garlic, lemon juice and seasoning.
Dice the cucumber, tomatoes and red onion.
Serve the chicken over rice (or in flatbreads) with the salad and garlic sauce.
recipes.tagline: Spiced chicken, garlic sauce and all the trimmings in a bowl.

recipes.name: Paneer tikka masala with fragrant rice
method: Cube the paneer and fry in half the oil until golden. Set aside.
Soften the chopped onion in the remaining oil for 6 minutes. Add the garlic and curry paste for 1 minute.
Add the tomatoes and simmer for 10 minutes. Stir in the cream and garam masala.
Add the paneer and simmer for 5 minutes. Cook the rice.
Serve the curry with the rice and coriander.
recipes.tagline: Golden paneer in a rich, creamy tikka sauce.

recipes.name: Cajun prawn tacos with mango slaw
method: Shred the cabbage, dice the mango and toss together with half the lime juice and coriander.
Toss the prawns in the Cajun seasoning and fry in the oil for 2-3 minutes until pink.
Mix the mayonnaise with the remaining lime juice.
Warm the tortillas and fill with slaw, prawns and lime mayo.
recipes.tagline: Spicy prawns in soft tacos with a fresh mango slaw.

recipes.name: Greek lemon-oregano chicken traybake
method: Heat the oven to 200C (180C fan). Cut the potatoes into wedges and the onion and pepper into chunks.
Toss everything in a large tray with the oil, oregano, lemon juice and zest, garlic and seasoning.
Nestle in the chicken, skin up, and roast for 45 minutes until golden and cooked through.
Scatter with crumbled feta and olives for the last 5 minutes.
recipes.tagline: Lemon and oregano chicken with crispy potatoes, all on one tray.

recipes.name: Japanese chicken katsu curry
method: For the sauce: soften the chopped onion and carrots in 1 tbsp oil for 8 minutes. Add the garlic, curry powder and 1 tbsp flour and cook for 1 minute.
Gradually add the stock, then the soy sauce and honey. Simmer for 15 minutes and blend until smooth.
Flatten the chicken to an even thickness. Coat in flour, then beaten egg, then panko.
Fry in the remaining oil for 4-5 minutes each side until golden and cooked through. Cook the rice.
Slice the katsu and serve on the rice with the curry sauce.
recipes.tagline: Crunchy breaded chicken with a mild, sweet curry sauce.

recipes.name: Creamy sun-dried tomato gnocchi with spinach
method: Fry the gnocchi in 1 tbsp of the sun-dried tomato oil for 5 minutes until golden.
Add the garlic and sun-dried tomatoes for 1 minute.
Pour in the cream and simmer for 2 minutes. Stir in the spinach until wilted, then the cheese.
Season and serve with basil.
recipes.tagline: Soft gnocchi in a creamy sun-dried tomato sauce.

recipes.name: Prawn laksa with rice noodles
method: Fry the laksa paste in a pan for 1 minute.
Add the coconut milk and stock and simmer for 8 minutes.
Soak or cook the noodles according to the packet. Add the prawns to the soup for 3 minutes until pink.
Season with fish sauce and lime juice.
Divide the noodles between bowls, ladle over the soup and top with beansprouts, chilli and coriander.
recipes.tagline: A big, fragrant bowl of coconut noodle soup with prawns.

recipes.name: Roasted vegetable and chickpea harissa couscous
method: Heat the oven to 220C (200C fan). Chop the vegetables and toss with the drained chickpeas, harissa and oil.
Roast for 20-25 minutes until charred at the edges.
Pour 200ml boiling water over the couscous, cover for 5 minutes, then fluff with lemon juice.
Fold the roasted vegetables into the couscous and finish with herbs.
recipes.tagline: Roasted veg and chickpeas with a gentle harissa kick.

recipes.name: Falafel pita with tahini slaw
method: Drain and dry the chickpeas. Blitz with the onion, garlic, herbs, cumin and flour until coarse. Shape into 10 small patties.
Fry in the oil for 3 minutes each side until crisp.
Whisk the tahini with lemon juice and 2-3 tbsp water, then toss with the shredded cabbage.
Warm the pittas and fill with the falafel and tahini slaw.
recipes.tagline: Crispy homemade falafel in warm pitta with tahini slaw.

recipes.name: Thai peanut noodle salad with crunchy vegetables
method: Cook the noodles, then rinse under cold water.
Whisk the peanut butter, soy sauce, vinegar, maple syrup and lime juice with 2-3 tbsp warm water.
Cut the vegetables into thin strips.
Toss the noodles with the vegetables and dressing. Top with coriander and peanuts.
recipes.tagline: Crunchy veg and noodles in a sweet peanut dressing.

recipes.name: Halloumi and roasted pepper wraps

ingredients.name: roasted red peppers from a jar

method: Slice the halloumi and fry in a dry pan for 2 minutes each side until golden.
Slice the peppers.
Spread the wraps with hummus, then add the rocket, peppers and halloumi. Squeeze over lemon and roll up.
recipes.tagline: Squeaky golden halloumi and sweet peppers, wrapped up.

recipes.name: Tuna Niçoise salad
method: Boil the potatoes for 12-15 minutes until tender, adding the green beans for the last 4 minutes.
Boil the eggs for 7 minutes, then cool in cold water and peel.
Whisk the mustard, vinegar and oil.
Arrange the lettuce, halved potatoes, beans, tomatoes, olives, tuna and halved eggs. Drizzle with the dressing.
recipes.tagline: Tuna, eggs, potatoes and beans: a proper filling salad.

recipes.name: Chicken banh mi-style baguette
method: Shred the carrot and cut the cucumber into ribbons. Soak in the vinegar and sugar for 10 minutes.
Toss the chicken in the soy sauce and honey and cook in a griddle pan for 4-5 minutes each side until cooked through. Slice.
Mix the mayonnaise with the sriracha.
Split the baguettes, spread with the spicy mayo and fill with chicken, pickled vegetables and coriander.
recipes.tagline: Sticky chicken in a crusty baguette with tangy pickled veg.

recipes.name: Mediterranean butter bean bruschetta
method: Drain the butter beans and roughly crush with half the oil, lemon juice and seasoning.
Toast the bread and rub with the cut garlic clove.
Chop the tomatoes and toss with basil and the remaining oil.
Top the toast with the crushed beans and tomatoes.
recipes.tagline: Garlicky butter beans and tomatoes piled on toast.

recipes.name: Prawn and avocado lime rice bowls
method: Cook the rice, then stir through the lime zest and half the lime juice.
Whisk the remaining lime juice with the soy sauce and sesame oil.
Slice the avocado, cucumber and radishes.
Top the rice with the prawns and vegetables, then drizzle with the dressing and add coriander.
recipes.tagline: Juicy prawns, creamy avocado and lime over rice.

recipes.name: Spiced lentil and roasted carrot salad
method: Heat the oven to 200C (180C fan). Cut the carrots into batons, toss with the spices and half the oil, and roast for 25 minutes.
Whisk the remaining oil with the lemon juice and maple syrup.
Toss the drained lentils, rocket and parsley with the dressing.
Top with the roasted carrots and pumpkin seeds.
recipes.tagline: Warm spiced lentils and sweet roasted carrots.

recipes.name: Greek chicken souvlaki flatbreads
method: Cut the chicken into chunks and toss with the lemon juice, oregano, half the garlic and the oil. Thread onto skewers if you like.
Grill or griddle for 10-12 minutes, turning, until cooked through.
Mix the yoghurt with the grated cucumber and remaining garlic to make tzatziki.
Warm the flatbreads and fill with chicken, tomato, red onion and tzatziki.
recipes.tagline: Lemony, garlicky chicken in soft flatbreads with yoghurt.

recipes.name: Turkish eggs with chilli butter and yoghurt
method: Mix the yoghurt with the grated garlic and a pinch of salt. Spread onto two plates.
Poach the eggs in gently simmering water with the vinegar for 3 minutes.
Melt the butter with the chilli and paprika until sizzling.
Place the eggs on the yoghurt, spoon over the chilli butter and finish with dill. Serve with toast.
recipes.tagline: Silky eggs on garlicky yoghurt with chilli butter.

recipes.name: Breakfast burrito with black beans and salsa
method: Warm the drained black beans with the cumin and a splash of water, then roughly mash.
Scramble the eggs in the oil over a low heat until just set.
Warm the tortillas. Fill with beans, eggs, cheese, salsa and sliced avocado.
Fold into burritos and toast seam-side down in a dry pan for 1-2 minutes.
recipes.tagline: Eggs, beans, cheese and salsa wrapped up for breakfast.

recipes.name: Blueberry lemon baked oats
method: Heat the oven to 180C (160C fan). Mash the banana, then mix with the egg, milk, lemon zest and honey.
Stir in the oats and baking powder, then fold in most of the blueberries.
Pour into a small baking dish, scatter over the remaining berries and bake for 25-30 minutes until set and golden.
recipes.tagline: Like a warm blueberry muffin, baked from oats.

recipes.name: Spinach and feta egg muffins
method: Heat the oven to 190C (170C fan). Oil a 6-hole muffin tin.
Whisk the eggs with the milk and seasoning. Chop the spinach and spring onions and add.
Divide between the holes, crumble over the feta and add half a tomato to each.
Bake for 18-20 minutes until set.
notes: Makes 6 muffins. Keep in the fridge for up to 3 days.
recipes.tagline: Grab-and-go egg muffins with spinach and feta.

recipes.name: Avocado toast with chilli-crisp eggs
method: Toast the sourdough. Mash the avocado with the lemon juice and seasoning and spread on the toast.
Heat the chilli crisp and vegetable oil in a pan and fry the eggs until the edges are crisp and the yolks runny.
Slide the eggs onto the toast and spoon over the chilli oil from the pan.
recipes.tagline: Smashed avocado on toast with chilli-crisp eggs.

recipes.name: Cinnamon pear bircher muesli
method: Mix the oats with the apple juice, yoghurt and cinnamon. Chill overnight.
In the morning, grate in half the pear and stir.
Top with the remaining sliced pear, hazelnuts and honey.
notes: Make the night before.
recipes.tagline: Creamy overnight oats with pear and cinnamon.

recipes.name: Masala omelette with coriander
method: Finely chop the onion, tomato, chilli and coriander.
Whisk the eggs with the turmeric, cumin, chopped vegetables, herbs and seasoning.
Pour into a hot oiled pan and cook for 2-3 minutes, then fold and cook for 1 minute more.
recipes.tagline: A fluffy spiced omelette with tomato and coriander.

recipes.name: Crispy air-fryer chickpeas with smoked paprika
method: Drain and dry the chickpeas well.
Toss with the oil, paprika, garlic powder and salt.
Air-fry at 200C for 12-15 minutes, shaking halfway, until crunchy. They crisp up more as they cool.
notes: No air fryer? Roast at 200C (180C fan) for 25-30 minutes.
recipes.tagline: Crunchy, smoky roasted chickpeas. Hard to stop eating.

recipes.name: Peanut butter date bites
method: Blitz everything in a food processor until it sticks together.
Roll into 12 balls and chill for 30 minutes.
notes: Makes about 12. Keep in the fridge for up to a week.
recipes.tagline: Fudgy chocolate peanut butter bites. No baking needed.

recipes.name: Mini caprese skewers
method: Thread tomatoes, basil leaves and mozzarella onto small skewers.
Drizzle with olive oil and balsamic glaze and season with pepper.
recipes.tagline: Tomato, mozzarella and basil on sticks.

recipes.name: Spiced roasted nuts with rosemary
method: Heat the oven to 180C (160C fan).
Toss the nuts with the oil, chopped rosemary, maple syrup, paprika and salt.
Roast for 10-12 minutes, stirring once, until golden. Cool before eating.
recipes.tagline: Warm, sweet and smoky roasted nuts.

recipes.name: Smoky black bean chilli with lime rice
method: Soften the chopped onion and pepper in the oil for 8 minutes. Add the garlic and spices for 1 minute.
Add the tomatoes, purée and drained beans with 150ml water. Simmer for 20 minutes until thick.
Cook the rice, then stir through the lime zest, juice and chopped coriander.
Serve the chilli over the lime rice.
recipes.tagline: Smoky, hearty bean chilli with zesty lime rice.

recipes.name: Red lentil coconut dhal with turmeric rice
method: Soften the chopped onion in the oil for 6 minutes. Add the garlic, ginger and spices for 1 minute.
Add the rinsed lentils, coconut milk and stock. Simmer for 20-25 minutes, stirring, until thick.
Cook the rice with a pinch of turmeric. Stir the spinach and lemon juice into the dhal.
Serve the dhal with the rice.
recipes.tagline: Golden, creamy lentil dhal that's pure comfort.

recipes.name: Caramelised onion and chickpea curry
method: Slowly cook the sliced onions in the oil for 15-20 minutes until deep golden.
Add the garlic and curry powder for 1 minute.
Add the tomatoes, drained chickpeas and coconut milk. Simmer for 15 minutes.
Stir in the garam masala. Serve with rice and coriander.
recipes.tagline: Sweet caramelised onions and chickpeas in a warming curry.

recipes.name: Tomato butter bean stew with garlic toast

ingredients.name: extra garlic clove for the toast

method: Gently cook the sliced garlic and paprika in the oil for 1 minute.
Add the tomatoes and drained beans and simmer for 8 minutes. Stir in the spinach until wilted.
Toast the bread and rub with the cut garlic.
Serve the stew with the garlic toast.
recipes.tagline: Rich tomato and butter bean stew with crunchy garlic toast.

recipes.name: Egg fried rice with peas and spring onion
method: Heat the vegetable oil in a wok until very hot. Add the peas and spring onion whites for 2 minutes.
Push to one side, add the beaten eggs and scramble until just set.
Add the rice and stir-fry for 3-4 minutes until piping hot.
Season with soy sauce and sesame oil and top with the spring onion greens.
notes: Cold, day-old rice works best. Cool cooked rice quickly and keep it in the fridge for no more than 1 day.
recipes.tagline: Better-than-takeaway egg fried rice in 15 minutes.

recipes.name: Creamy lemon pea pasta
method: Cook the pasta, adding the peas for the last 3 minutes. Keep a cup of the water.
Drain, then return to the pan with the soft cheese, lemon zest and juice, and a splash of cooking water.
Toss until creamy. Finish with grated cheese and herbs.
recipes.tagline: Creamy, zesty pasta with sweet peas.

recipes.name: Spanish-style chickpea and spinach stew
method: Soften the chopped onion in the oil for 6 minutes. Add the garlic and spices for 1 minute.
Add the tomatoes and drained chickpeas and simmer for 12 minutes.
Stir in the spinach until wilted. Season and serve with crusty bread.
recipes.tagline: Smoky Spanish-style chickpeas and spinach.

recipes.name: One-pot smoky sausage and bean casserole

ingredients.name: potatoes, or crusty bread to serve

method: Brown the sausages in the oil, then cut into chunks.
Soften the chopped onion and pepper for 6 minutes. Add the garlic and paprika for 1 minute.
Add the tomatoes, drained beans, stock and sausages. Simmer for 20-25 minutes until thick.
Serve with boiled potatoes or crusty bread.
recipes.tagline: Sausages and beans in a smoky tomato sauce.

recipes.name: Crispy potato and black bean tacos
method: Dice the potatoes into 1cm cubes. Fry in the oil for 15-20 minutes, turning, until crisp and cooked through. Toss with the spices.
Warm the drained beans with a splash of water and lightly mash.
Warm the tortillas and fill with beans, potatoes, avocado and salsa. Finish with lime.
recipes.tagline: Crispy spiced potatoes and black beans in soft tacos.

recipes.name: Chicken thigh traybake with paprika potatoes
method: Heat the oven to 200C (180C fan). Cut the potatoes into chunks and the onions into wedges.
Toss with the oil, paprika, garlic and seasoning in a large roasting tin.
Add the chicken, skin-side up, rub with a little more paprika and roast for 45 minutes until cooked through.
Steam the greens and serve alongside.
recipes.tagline: Crispy chicken thighs and paprika potatoes, all on one tray.

recipes.name: Tuna and sweetcorn pasta bake
method: Heat the oven to 200C (180C fan). Cook the pasta for 2 minutes less than the packet says.
Melt the butter, stir in the flour for 1 minute, then whisk in the milk gradually. Simmer until thick, then add the mustard and most of the cheese.
Mix the pasta, tuna and sweetcorn into the sauce. Tip into a dish and top with the remaining cheese.
Bake for 15-20 minutes until golden and bubbling.
recipes.tagline: Creamy, cheesy tuna pasta bake. A family classic.

recipes.name: Lentil spaghetti bolognese
method: Finely chop the onion, carrots and celery and soften in the oil for 10 minutes. Add the garlic for 1 minute.
Add the drained lentils, tomatoes, purée and oregano. Simmer for 20 minutes.
Cook the spaghetti and serve with the bolognese.
recipes.tagline: A rich bolognese made with lentils.

recipes.name: Sweet potato and peanut stew
method: Soften the chopped onion in the oil for 6 minutes. Add the garlic, ginger and cumin for 1 minute.
Add the peeled, diced sweet potato, tomatoes, peanut butter and stock. Simmer for 20 minutes until the potato is tender.
Stir in the greens until wilted. Cook the rice.
Serve the stew with rice, topped with chopped peanuts.
recipes.tagline: A creamy, gently spiced sweet potato and peanut stew.

recipes.name: Moroccan carrot and chickpea couscous
method: Heat the oven to 200C (180C fan). Cut the carrots into chunks and toss with the drained chickpeas, spices and oil. Roast for 25 minutes.
Pour 200ml boiling water over the couscous and raisins, cover for 5 minutes, then fluff with lemon juice.
Fold through the roasted carrots and chickpeas, and finish with herbs.
recipes.tagline: Sweet roasted carrots and spiced chickpeas with fluffy couscous.

recipes.name: Tomato and egg shakshuka with toast
method: Soften the chopped onion in the oil for 5 minutes. Add the garlic and spices for 1 minute.
Add the tomatoes and simmer for 6 minutes.
Make four hollows, crack in the eggs, cover and cook for 5-6 minutes until the whites are set.
Serve with toast.
recipes.tagline: Eggs baked in spiced tomatoes, with toast for dipping.

recipes.name: Cheesy broccoli baked potatoes
method: Heat the oven to 200C (180C fan). Prick the potatoes and bake for 50-60 minutes until crisp outside and soft inside.
Steam the broccoli florets for 4 minutes, then chop.
Halve the potatoes, scoop out and mash the flesh with the crème fraîche, mustard, broccoli and most of the cheese.
Spoon back into the skins, top with the remaining cheese and bake for 10 minutes until golden.
notes: Short on time? Microwave the potatoes for 8-10 minutes, then crisp in the oven for 10 minutes.
recipes.tagline: Crispy jackets loaded with cheesy broccoli.

recipes.name: Chicken noodle soup
method: Soften the chopped onion, carrots and celery in the oil for 8 minutes.
Add the stock and whole chicken. Simmer for 15 minutes until the chicken is cooked through, then lift out and shred.
Add the noodles and peas to the pot and cook for 4-5 minutes.
Return the chicken, season and finish with parsley.
recipes.tagline: A comforting bowl of chicken noodle soup.

recipes.name: Italian chickpea pasta (pasta e ceci)
method: Gently cook the garlic, rosemary and chilli in the oil for 2 minutes. Stir in the tomato purée.
Add the chickpeas (with their liquid) and the stock. Simmer for 5 minutes, then mash a third of the chickpeas to thicken.
Add the pasta and cook, stirring often, for 10-12 minutes until tender and thick. Add water if needed.
Season and finish with a drizzle of olive oil.
recipes.tagline: Silky Italian chickpea pasta. Simple and so satisfying.

recipes.name: Curried potato and pea samosa bowls
method: Cut the potatoes into 2cm cubes and boil for 8 minutes, then drain.
Fry the cumin seeds and chopped onion in the oil for 5 minutes. Add the garlic and curry powder.
Add the potatoes and fry until crisp at the edges. Stir in the peas for 3 minutes.
Cook the rice. Serve in bowls topped with the samosa filling, chutney and coriander.
recipes.tagline: Everything you love about samosas, in a bowl.

recipes.name: Chilli garlic mackerel rice
method: Cook the rice, adding the peas for the last 3 minutes.
Heat 1 tbsp of oil from the mackerel tin and fry the garlic and chilli for 1 minute.
Add the flaked mackerel and soy sauce and warm through.
Spoon over the rice and finish with spring onions and lime.
recipes.tagline: Spicy, garlicky mackerel over rice in 15 minutes.

recipes.name: Mexican rice and bean stuffed peppers
method: Heat the oven to 200C (180C fan). Halve and deseed the peppers and roast for 10 minutes.
Mix the rice, drained beans and sweetcorn, half the tomatoes, the spices and seasoning.
Fill the peppers, spoon the remaining tomatoes around them and bake for 25 minutes.
Finish with lime and coriander.
recipes.tagline: Peppers stuffed with spiced rice, beans and sweetcorn.

recipes.name: Tomato lentil soup with toasted bread
method: Soften the chopped onion and carrots in the oil for 6 minutes. Add the garlic and cumin.
Add the lentils, tomatoes and stock. Simmer for 20 minutes until the lentils are soft.
Blend until smooth, season, and serve with toast.
recipes.tagline: Thick tomato and lentil soup with toast for dunking.

recipes.name: Tuna sweetcorn jacket potato
method: Heat the oven to 200C (180C fan). Prick the potatoes and bake for 50-60 minutes.
Mix the tuna, sweetcorn, mayonnaise and black pepper.
Split the potatoes and fill with the tuna mix. Serve with salad.
notes: Short on time? Microwave the potatoes for 8-10 minutes.
recipes.tagline: Crispy jacket potato with tuna and sweetcorn.

recipes.name: Peanut sesame noodles with shredded cabbage
method: Cook the noodles and rinse in cold water.
Whisk the peanut butter, soy sauce, sesame oil and vinegar with 2 tbsp warm water.
Toss the noodles with the finely shredded cabbage and dressing, then top with spring onions and sesame seeds.
recipes.tagline: Peanut sesame noodles with crunchy cabbage.

recipes.name: Black bean quesadillas with salsa
method: Drain the beans and mash with the cumin and lime juice.
Spread over two tortillas, scatter with cheese and top with the other tortillas.
Cook in a dry pan for 2-3 minutes each side until crisp and melted. Cut into wedges and serve with salsa.
recipes.tagline: Crispy, cheesy black bean quesadillas.

recipes.name: Homemade minestrone with beans
method: Soften the chopped onion, carrots and celery in the oil for 8 minutes. Add the garlic.
Add the tomatoes, beans and stock and simmer for 10 minutes.
Add the pasta and shredded cabbage and cook for 10 minutes more. Season.
recipes.tagline: A big, hearty bowl of veg and bean soup.

recipes.name: Roasted vegetable hummus pitas
method: Heat the oven to 220C (200C fan). Chop the vegetables, toss with the oil and herbs and roast for 25 minutes.
Warm the pittas, spread with hummus, and fill with spinach and the roasted vegetables.
recipes.tagline: Roasted veg and hummus stuffed into warm pitta.

recipes.name: Spiced carrot soup with yoghurt swirl
method: Soften the chopped onion in the oil for 5 minutes. Add the spices for 1 minute.
Add the chopped carrots and stock. Simmer for 20 minutes until soft.
Blend until smooth and season. Serve with a swirl of yoghurt.
recipes.tagline: Smooth, gently spiced carrot soup.

recipes.name: Leftover chilli loaded potatoes
method: Heat the oven to 200C (180C fan). Prick and bake the potatoes for 50-60 minutes (or microwave for 8-10 minutes).
Reheat the chilli until piping hot.
Split the potatoes and fill with chilli, yoghurt and sliced spring onions.
notes: Uses leftovers from recipe 081.
recipes.tagline: Jacket potatoes loaded with yesterday's chilli.

recipes.name: Pesto pea and butter bean pasta salad
method: Cook the pasta, adding the peas for the last 3 minutes. Drain and rinse in cold water.
Toss with the drained butter beans, pesto and lemon juice.
Fold through the rocket. Serve cold or at room temperature.
notes: Uses vegetarian pesto (made without parmesan), so it's suitable for vegetarians.
recipes.tagline: A fresh pesto pasta salad with peas and beans.

recipes.name: Cinnamon apple porridge
method: Grate the apple.
Simmer the oats, milk, apple and cinnamon for 5-6 minutes, stirring, until creamy.
Serve with a drizzle of maple syrup.
recipes.tagline: Warm, creamy porridge with cinnamon apples.

recipes.name: Peanut butter banana overnight oats
method: Mix the oats, milk, peanut butter and half the mashed banana. Chill overnight.
Top with the remaining sliced banana and maple syrup.
notes: Make the night before.
recipes.tagline: Peanut butter and banana oats, ready when you wake up.

recipes.name: Budget berry yoghurt oats
method: Mix the oats into the yoghurt and leave for 5 minutes (or overnight in the fridge).
Top with the berries and honey.
recipes.tagline: Creamy oats with berries and a drizzle of honey.

recipes.name: Banana oat pancakes
method: Blend the banana, eggs, oats and baking powder into a batter.
Fry small pancakes in a lightly oiled pan for 2 minutes each side.
Serve with yoghurt and fruit.
recipes.tagline: Three-ingredient banana pancakes.

recipes.name: Popcorn with smoked paprika
method: Heat the oil in a large pan with a lid. Add the kernels, cover and shake over a medium heat until the popping slows.
Toss with the paprika and salt.
recipes.tagline: Light, crunchy popcorn with a smoky kick.

recipes.name: Homemade oat and raisin flapjacks
method: Heat the oven to 180C (160C fan) and line a 20cm square tin.
Melt the butter, syrup and sugar, then stir in the oats and raisins.
Press into the tin and bake for 20-25 minutes until golden. Cut while warm and cool in the tin.
notes: Makes 12 squares.
recipes.tagline: Chewy, golden oat and raisin flapjacks.

recipes.name: Crispy roasted potato wedges with salsa
method: Heat the oven to 220C (200C fan). Cut the potatoes into wedges and toss with the oil, paprika and salt.
Roast for 30-35 minutes, turning once, until crisp.
Serve with salsa.
recipes.tagline: Crispy potato wedges with salsa for dipping.

recipes.name: Rich spaghetti bolognese
method: Fry the chopped onion and grated carrot in the oil for 5 minutes. Add the garlic for 1 minute.
Add the mince and brown it, breaking it up with a spoon.
Stir in the tomatoes, purée, crumbled stock cube, herbs and 150ml water. Simmer for 25 minutes until thick.
Cook the spaghetti, drain and serve with the sauce and a little grated cheese.
notes: Leftover sauce freezes well for up to 3 months.
recipes.tagline: A rich, slow-simmered bolognese the whole family loves.

recipes.name: Chilli con carne with rice
method: Fry the chopped onion and pepper in the oil for 5 minutes. Add the garlic and spices for 1 minute.
Add the mince and brown it.
Add the tomatoes, drained beans, crumbled stock cube and 150ml water. Simmer for 25 minutes.
Cook the rice and serve with the chilli.
recipes.tagline: Hearty, warming chilli with fluffy rice.

recipes.name: Cottage pie
method: Heat the oven to 200C (180C fan). Peel the potatoes, cut into chunks and boil for 15-20 minutes until soft.
Meanwhile fry the chopped onion and diced carrots in the oil for 5 minutes, then brown the mince.
Stir in the flour and purée, then the Worcestershire sauce, crumbled stock cube and 300ml water. Simmer for 15 minutes, adding the peas for the last 2.
Mash the potatoes with the butter and milk. Spoon the mince into a dish, top with the mash and bake for 20 minutes until golden.
recipes.tagline: Rich mince under fluffy golden mash.

recipes.name: Sausage and mash with onion gravy
method: Heat the oven to 200C (180C fan) and cook the sausages on a tray for 25 minutes, turning once.
Peel and chop the potatoes and boil for 15-20 minutes until soft. Drain and mash with the butter and milk.
Slice the onions and cook slowly in the oil for 15 minutes until soft and golden. Make the gravy with boiling water as the packet says and stir in the onions.
Cook the peas and serve everything together.
recipes.tagline: Juicy sausages, creamy mash and sticky onion gravy.

recipes.name: Toad in the hole
method: Heat the oven to 220C (200C fan). Put the sausages and oil in a roasting tin and cook for 10 minutes.
Whisk the flour, eggs, milk and a pinch of salt into a smooth batter.
Pour the batter around the hot sausages and bake for 25 minutes until risen and golden. Don't open the oven door.
Meanwhile boil the potatoes and peas. Make the gravy as the packet says and serve.
recipes.tagline: Sausages in a big, crispy Yorkshire pudding.

recipes.name: Easy chicken curry
method: Cut the chicken into bite-sized pieces. Fry the chopped onion in the oil for 5 minutes, then add the garlic, grated ginger and curry powder for 1 minute.
Add the chicken and cook for 5 minutes, then add the tomatoes and 100ml water. Simmer for 20 minutes until the chicken is cooked through.
Take off the heat and stir in the yoghurt.
Cook the rice and serve with the curry.
recipes.tagline: A mild, comforting chicken curry everyone will eat.

recipes.name: Chicken fajitas
method: Slice the chicken, peppers and onion into strips. Toss with the spices and oil.
Fry in a hot pan for 10-12 minutes until the chicken is cooked through.
Warm the wraps and fill with the chicken, grated cheese, shredded lettuce and a spoonful of yoghurt.
recipes.tagline: Sizzling spiced chicken and peppers, wrapped your way.

recipes.name: Slow-cooked beef stew
method: Heat the oven to 160C (140C fan). Toss the beef in the flour and brown it in batches in the oil in an ovenproof pan.
Add the chopped onion and cook for 5 minutes. Add the carrots and potatoes in chunks, the purée, herbs, crumbled stock cube and 600ml water.
Cover and cook in the oven for 2 hours until the beef is tender. Serve with bread.
notes: Also works in a slow cooker: 7-8 hours on low.
recipes.tagline: Tender beef and veg slow-cooked in a rich gravy.

recipes.name: Sausage pasta bake
method: Heat the oven to 200C (180C fan). Squeeze the sausages out of their skins in small pieces and fry in the oil until browned.
Add the chopped onion and garlic for 5 minutes, then the tomatoes and herbs. Simmer for 10 minutes.
Cook the pasta for 2 minutes less than the packet says, drain and mix with the sauce.
Tip into a dish, top with the grated cheese and bake for 15 minutes.
recipes.tagline: Sausage, tomato and pasta under bubbling cheese.

recipes.name: Chicken and mushroom pie
method: Heat the oven to 200C (180C fan). Cut the chicken into pieces and fry with the chopped onion and sliced mushrooms in the oil for 10 minutes.
Stir in the flour, then the milk and the stock cube dissolved in 200ml boiling water. Simmer until thick.
Tip into a pie dish, cover with the pastry, brush with beaten egg and bake for 25 minutes until golden.
Serve with boiled potatoes and peas.
recipes.tagline: Creamy chicken and mushrooms under golden puff pastry.

recipes.name: Creamy bacon and pea pasta
method: Cook the pasta, adding the peas for the last 3 minutes.
Meanwhile chop the bacon and fry until crisp, adding the garlic for the last minute.
Beat the eggs with the grated cheese.
Drain the pasta, keeping a mugful of the water. Off the heat, toss the pasta with the bacon, then the egg mix and a splash of the water until creamy.
recipes.tagline: Crispy bacon and peas in a creamy, cheesy sauce.

recipes.name: One-pot chicken and rice
method: Brown the chicken pieces in the oil in a large pan, then add the chopped onion, pepper and garlic for 5 minutes.
Stir in the paprika and rice, then the stock cube dissolved in 750ml boiling water.
Cover and simmer for 20 minutes, adding the peas for the last 5, until the rice is tender and the chicken cooked through.
recipes.tagline: Paprika chicken and rice cooked together in one pot.

recipes.name: Spaghetti and meatballs
method: Mix the mince with half the finely chopped onion and the herbs and roll into about 20 meatballs.
Brown the meatballs in the oil, then set aside. Soften the rest of the onion and the garlic in the same pan.
Add the tomatoes and purée, return the meatballs and simmer for 20 minutes until cooked through.
Cook the spaghetti and serve with the meatballs and sauce.
recipes.tagline: Juicy beef meatballs in a rich tomato sauce.

recipes.name: Chicken wraps
method: Slice the chicken thinly, toss with the paprika and fry for 8-10 minutes until cooked through.
Fill the wraps with lettuce, sliced tomato, the chicken and a little mayonnaise, and roll up.
recipes.tagline: Smoky chicken wraps with crunchy lettuce.

recipes.name: Chicken and sweetcorn pasta salad
method: Cook the pasta, then rinse under cold water and drain.
Poach or fry the chicken for 10-12 minutes until cooked through, then cool and slice.
Mix the pasta with the chicken, drained sweetcorn, chopped pepper, mayonnaise and yoghurt.
notes: Keeps in the fridge for 2 days: good for packed lunches.
recipes.tagline: Creamy chicken and sweetcorn pasta salad. Great for lunchboxes.

recipes.name: Takeaway-style butter chicken
method: Cut the chicken into chunks and mix with half the yoghurt and half the tikka paste. Leave for 10 minutes (or overnight in the fridge).
Melt the butter and soften the chopped onion for 8 minutes. Add the garlic, grated ginger and the rest of the paste for 1 minute.
Add the tomatoes and simmer for 10 minutes, then blend until smooth (or leave chunky).
Add the chicken and cook gently for 15 minutes until cooked through. Stir in the cream, garam masala and the rest of the yoghurt.
Serve with the rice and warm naan.
recipes.tagline: Rich, mild and creamy: the takeaway favourite at a fraction of the price.

recipes.name: Salt and pepper chicken
method: Cut the chicken into bite-sized pieces and toss with the cornflour, five spice, a big pinch of salt and lots of black pepper.
Fry in the oil in batches for 6-8 minutes until crisp and cooked through. Set aside.
In the same pan, stir-fry the sliced onion, pepper, chilli and garlic for 3 minutes.
Toss the chicken back in with the spring onions and serve with rice.
recipes.tagline: Crispy, peppery chicken with onions and chilli, just like the chippy's.

recipes.name: Sweet and sour chicken
method: Cut the chicken into chunks, toss in 2 tbsp of the cornflour and fry in the oil until golden and cooked through.
Add the chopped pepper and onion and stir-fry for 3 minutes.
Mix the pineapple juice from the tin with the ketchup, vinegar, soy sauce, sugar and the rest of the cornflour. Pour in with the pineapple chunks and bubble until glossy.
Serve with rice.
recipes.tagline: Sticky, tangy and bright: better than the takeaway and ready in 35 minutes.

recipes.name: Chicken chow mein
method: Cook the noodles as the packet says and drain.
Slice the chicken thinly and stir-fry in the oil for 5-6 minutes until cooked through.
Add the sliced pepper, carrot, cabbage and garlic and stir-fry for 3 minutes.
Add the noodles, soy sauce, honey and sesame oil and toss over a high heat for 2 minutes. Scatter with spring onions.
recipes.tagline: Saucy noodles, tender chicken and crunchy veg in one pan.

recipes.name: Kebab night: spiced chicken flatbreads with garlic sauce
method: Mix the chicken with the spices, half the lemon juice and the oil.
Cook under a hot grill or in a griddle pan for 20-25 minutes, turning, until charred and cooked through. Slice.
Mix the yoghurt with the crushed garlic, the rest of the lemon juice and a pinch of salt.
Warm the flatbreads and load with lettuce, tomato, thinly sliced red onion, the chicken and plenty of garlic sauce.
recipes.tagline: Spiced, charred chicken in warm flatbreads with garlic sauce: kebab night at home.

recipes.name: Smash burgers and chips
method: Cook the oven chips as the packet says.
Divide the mince into 8 balls. Heat a heavy pan until very hot, add a ball and press it flat with a spatula. Season and cook for 2 minutes, flip, add cheese and cook for 1 minute more.
Stack two patties in each toasted bun with lettuce, tomato, finely chopped onion and a mix of ketchup and mayonnaise.
Serve with the chips.
recipes.tagline: Crispy-edged, juicy burgers with melted cheese: the chain-restaurant kind, at home.

recipes.name: Peri-peri chicken with spicy rice
method: Heat the oven to 200C (180C fan). Rub the chicken with the seasoning, lemon juice and half the oil and roast for 35 minutes until crisp and cooked through.
Meanwhile fry the chopped onion and pepper in the rest of the oil for 5 minutes. Add the paprika and rice.
Pour in the stock cube dissolved in 650ml boiling water, cover and simmer for 15 minutes, adding the peas for the last 3.
Serve the chicken on the rice.
recipes.tagline: Fiery, smoky chicken with spicy rice: the restaurant favourite, homemade.

recipes.name: Loaded chilli cheese fries
method: Cook the chips as the packet says.
Brown the mince with the chopped onion, add the spices, drained beans and tomatoes and simmer for 15 minutes until thick.
Pile the chips on a tray, spoon over the chilli, scatter with cheese and grill until melted.
Top with sliced spring onions and a little yoghurt.
recipes.tagline: Crispy chips piled with chilli beef and melted cheese. Share it if you can.

recipes.name: 20-minute flatbread pizzas
method: Heat the oven to 220C (200C fan). Simmer the tomatoes with the herbs for 8 minutes until thick.
Spread over the flatbreads and top with torn mozzarella, ham, sliced mushrooms and pepper.
Bake for 10-12 minutes until bubbling and crisp.
recipes.tagline: Crisp, bubbling pizzas in 20 minutes, no dough to make.

recipes.name: Crispy chicken burgers with slaw
method: Cook the chips as the packet says. Slice each chicken breast in half horizontally to make 4 thin fillets.
Dust in flour and paprika, dip in beaten egg, then press into the breadcrumbs.
Fry in the oil for 4-5 minutes each side until golden and cooked through.
Mix the shredded cabbage and grated carrot with the mayonnaise. Fill the buns with chicken and slaw.
recipes.tagline: Golden, crunchy chicken burgers with a creamy, tangy slaw.

recipes.name: Garlic beef and broccoli
method: Slice the steak very thinly and toss with 1 tsp cornflour. Cook the rice.
Stir-fry the steak in the hot oil for 2 minutes and set aside.
Stir-fry the broccoli florets with a splash of water for 3 minutes, then add the garlic and ginger.
Mix the soy sauce, honey, the rest of the cornflour and 100ml water, add to the pan with the beef and bubble until glossy. Serve with rice.
recipes.tagline: Tender beef and broccoli in a glossy garlic sauce. Faster than delivery.

recipes.name: Chicken tikka masala
method: Mix the chicken chunks with the yoghurt and 1 tbsp of the paste. Grill or pan-fry until charred at the edges.
Soften the onion, pepper and garlic in the oil, then add the rest of the paste for 1 minute.
Add the tomatoes and simmer for 10 minutes. Add the chicken and simmer 10 minutes more, then stir in the cream.
Serve with rice.
recipes.tagline: Smoky, spiced and creamy: Britain's favourite curry, made easy.

recipes.name: Sticky honey-garlic chicken thighs
method: Heat the oven to 200C (180C fan). Roast the chicken thighs for 20 minutes.
Mix the honey, soy sauce and crushed garlic, pour over the chicken and roast for 10-15 minutes more, basting, until sticky and cooked through.
Cook the rice and steam the broccoli.
Scatter the chicken with sesame seeds and spring onions and serve.
recipes.tagline: Sticky, sweet and garlicky thighs that everyone fights over.

recipes.name: Korean-style crispy beef rice bowls
method: Cook the rice. Fry the mince in a hot pan until browned and crispy at the edges.
Add the garlic, gochujang, soy sauce and honey and cook for 2 minutes until sticky.
Fry the eggs. Grate the carrot and slice the cucumber.
Serve the mince on rice with the veg, a fried egg and spring onions on top.
recipes.tagline: Sweet, spicy, crispy mince over rice with a fried egg. Big flavour, small bill.

recipes.name: Loaded sweet potatoes with spiced mince and cheese
method: Heat the oven to 200C (180C fan). Prick the sweet potatoes and bake for 45-50 minutes until soft.
Fry the mince until browned, then add the chopped onion, pepper and garlic for 5 minutes.
Stir in the spices and tomatoes and simmer for 15 minutes. Stir in the spinach until wilted.
Split the potatoes, pile in the mince, top with cheese and grill until melted. Finish with a spoonful of yoghurt.
recipes.tagline: Fluffy sweet potatoes piled with spiced mince and melted cheese. A family favourite.

recipes.name: Proper beef lasagne
method: Brown the mince with the chopped onion, carrot and garlic. Add the tomatoes, purée and herbs and simmer for 20 minutes.
Melt the butter, stir in the flour for 1 minute, then whisk in the milk gradually until thick. Stir in two-thirds of the cheese.
Heat the oven to 190C (170C fan). Layer the meat sauce, lasagne sheets and cheese sauce in a dish, finishing with cheese sauce. Top with the rest of the cheese.
Bake for 35-40 minutes until golden and bubbling. Rest for 10 minutes before cutting.
recipes.tagline: Layers of rich beef ragù and creamy cheese sauce, baked until bubbling.

recipes.name: Ultimate mac and cheese
method: Heat the oven to 200C (180C fan). Cook the macaroni and the broccoli florets together for 2 minutes less than the packet says. Drain.
Melt the butter, stir in the flour, then whisk in the milk until thick. Off the heat, stir in most of the cheese and the mustard.
Mix with the pasta and broccoli and tip into a dish. Top with the rest of the cheese and breadcrumbs made from the bread.
Bake for 15 minutes until golden.
recipes.tagline: Proper oozy mac and cheese with a crunchy golden top.

recipes.name: Creamy garlic chicken with spinach and mash
method: Boil the peeled potatoes until soft, then mash with the butter.
Season the chicken and fry skin-side down in the oil for 10 minutes until golden, then turn and cook for 10 minutes more until cooked through.
Lift out the chicken, soften the garlic in the pan, then add the cream and the stock cube dissolved in 100ml boiling water. Simmer for 3 minutes.
Stir in the spinach and cheese, return the chicken and serve with the mash.
recipes.tagline: Golden chicken in a silky garlic and spinach sauce, with buttery mash.

recipes.name: One-pot lemon chicken orzo
method: Brown the chicken pieces in the oil in a deep pan. Add the chopped onion and garlic for 3 minutes.
Stir in the orzo, then add the stock cube dissolved in 800ml boiling water. Simmer for 12-15 minutes, stirring often, until the orzo is tender.
Stir in the peas and spinach for 2 minutes, then the lemon zest and juice and the cheese.
recipes.tagline: Creamy, lemony, one-pot orzo with chicken. Hardly any washing up.

recipes.name: Crispy lemon and herb chicken legs with potatoes
method: Heat the oven to 200C (180C fan). Cut the potatoes into chunks and toss on a tray with the oil, herbs, whole garlic cloves and lemon wedges.
Sit the seasoned chicken legs on top and roast for 45-50 minutes until the skin is crisp and the chicken cooked through.
Steam the broccoli and serve with the chicken, squeezing the roasted lemon over.
recipes.tagline: Crispy-skinned chicken legs on lemony, herby potatoes. One tray, no fuss.

recipes.name: Chicken stew with fluffy dumplings
method: Brown the chicken pieces in the oil in a large pan. Add the chopped onion, carrots and potatoes for 5 minutes.
Stir in the plain flour and herbs, then the stock cube dissolved in 800ml boiling water. Cover and simmer for 30 minutes.
Rub the butter into the self-raising flour with a pinch of salt, then add enough cold water to make a soft dough. Roll into 8 balls.
Stir the peas into the stew, sit the dumplings on top, cover and simmer for 20 minutes until risen and fluffy.
recipes.tagline: A big, warming pot of chicken and veg stew with fluffy dumplings on top.

recipes.name: Cheesy beef enchiladas
method: Heat the oven to 200C (180C fan). Brown the mince with the onion and pepper, then add the spices, beans and one tin of tomatoes. Simmer for 10 minutes.
Fill each tortilla with the mince mix, roll up and lay in a dish.
Pour the second tin of tomatoes (seasoned) over the top and cover with cheese.
Bake for 20 minutes until bubbling.
recipes.tagline: Rolled tortillas filled with spiced beef and beans, baked under bubbling cheese.

recipes.name: Meatball subs with melted mozzarella
method: Mix the mince with the herbs, half the garlic and a pinch of salt and roll into 16 meatballs. Brown in the oil.
Add the rest of the garlic, the tomatoes and purée and simmer for 15 minutes until the meatballs are cooked through.
Split the rolls, fill with meatballs and sauce, top with torn mozzarella and grill until melted.
recipes.tagline: Juicy meatballs in tomato sauce, stuffed into rolls with melted mozzarella.

recipes.name: Slow-cooked BBQ pulled pork buns
method: Heat the oven to 150C (130C fan). Rub the pork with the paprika, garlic granules, sugar and salt and sit it on the sliced onion in a covered dish with 200ml water.
Cook for 4 hours until it pulls apart easily (or 8 hours on low in a slow cooker).
Shred with two forks and stir in the BBQ sauce and some of the cooking juices.
Mix the shredded cabbage and grated carrot with the mayonnaise. Pile the pork and slaw into the buns.
notes: Leftovers freeze well, and make great wraps or jacket potato toppings.
recipes.tagline: Fall-apart, smoky pulled pork in soft buns with crunchy slaw.

recipes.name: Cajun chicken with sweetcorn rice
method: Toss the chicken in the seasoning and oil and pan-fry or grill for 20-25 minutes until charred and cooked through.
Cook the rice. Fry the drained sweetcorn and chopped pepper in the butter until lightly charred, then stir through the rice with the spring onions.
Slice the chicken and serve on the rice with lime wedges.
recipes.tagline: Spicy, smoky chicken with buttery sweetcorn rice. A weeknight winner.

recipes.name: Honey-mustard sausage traybake
method: Heat the oven to 200C (180C fan). Toss the potato chunks, onion wedges and carrot batons in the oil on a big tray and roast for 15 minutes.
Add the sausages and roast for 20 minutes more.
Mix the honey and mustard, pour over everything and return to the oven for 5 minutes until sticky. Serve with peas.
recipes.tagline: Sticky sausages and crispy potatoes in a honey-mustard glaze, all on one tray.

recipes.name: Crispy garlic pork noodles
method: Cook the noodles. Fry the mince in a hot dry pan until browned and crispy.
Add the garlic, ginger, chilli and shredded cabbage for 3 minutes.
Add the soy sauce, honey and noodles, toss well and finish with spring onions.
recipes.tagline: Crispy pork mince with garlic, chilli and noodles. Big flavour in 25 minutes.

recipes.name: Fish finger tacos with lime slaw
method: Cook the fish fingers as the packet says.
Mix the shredded cabbage and grated carrot with the lime juice and mayonnaise.
Warm the wraps and fill with slaw, sweetcorn and fish fingers.
recipes.tagline: Crispy fish fingers in soft tacos with zingy lime slaw. Kids love building their own.

recipes.name: Creamy chicken and broccoli pasta bake
method: Heat the oven to 200C (180C fan). Cook the pasta, adding the broccoli for the last 3 minutes. Drain.
Fry the chicken pieces in the oil until cooked through.
Melt the soft cheese with the milk and crumbled stock cube into a sauce. Mix everything together.
Tip into a dish, top with the cheddar and bake for 15 minutes until golden.
recipes.tagline: Creamy chicken, broccoli and pasta baked under a cheesy crust.

recipes.name: Creamy sun-dried tomato chicken pasta
method: Cook the pasta. Fry the seasoned chicken pieces in the oil until golden and cooked through.
Add the garlic and chopped sun-dried tomatoes for 1 minute, then the cream. Simmer for 3 minutes.
Stir in the spinach and cheese, then the drained pasta with a splash of its water.
recipes.tagline: Creamy sun-dried tomato and spinach chicken pasta. Feels fancy, costs little.

recipes.name: Chicken Caesar wraps
method: Cook the chicken in a pan for 10-12 minutes until cooked through, then slice. Toast the bread and cut into small croutons.
Mix the mayonnaise with the crushed garlic, lemon juice and most of the grated cheese.
Toss the shredded lettuce with the dressing, then fill the wraps with lettuce, chicken, croutons and the rest of the cheese.
recipes.tagline: Crunchy, creamy chicken Caesar, wrapped up to go.

recipes.name: Cheesy beef quesadillas
method: Fry the mince until browned, add the spices and the drained, roughly mashed beans and cook for 5 minutes.
Spread over half of each tortilla, scatter with cheese and fold over.
Cook in a dry pan for 2-3 minutes each side until crisp and melted. Cut into wedges and serve with salsa.
recipes.tagline: Spiced beef and melting cheese in crisp, golden tortillas.

recipes.name: Loaded potato skins with bacon and cheese
method: Heat the oven to 200C (180C fan). Rub the potatoes with oil and salt and bake for 1 hour until crisp.
Fry the chopped bacon until crisp.
Halve the potatoes, scoop out some of the middle, and mix it with half the cheese and bacon. Spoon back in, top with the rest of the cheese and bake for 10 minutes.
Finish with spring onions and yoghurt.
recipes.tagline: Crispy potato skins loaded with bacon, cheese and spring onions.

recipes.name: Peanut chicken noodle pots
method: Cook the noodles and poach or pan-fry the chicken until cooked through, then shred.
Whisk the peanut butter, soy sauce, honey and lime juice with 3 tbsp hot water until smooth.
Toss the noodles, chicken, grated carrot, sliced pepper and spring onions in the sauce.
notes: Keeps in the fridge for 2 days, so it's good for packed lunches.
recipes.tagline: Silky peanut noodles with chicken and crunchy veg. Great hot or cold.

recipes.name: Chilli cheese jacket potatoes
method: Heat the oven to 200C (180C fan) and bake the pricked potatoes for 1 hour until crisp.
Brown the mince with the onion, add the chilli powder, beans and tomatoes and simmer for 20 minutes.
Split the potatoes, spoon in the chilli and top with cheese.
recipes.tagline: Crispy jackets loaded with quick chilli and melted cheese.

recipes.name: Tuna melt toasties
method: Mix the drained tuna with the mayonnaise and sweetcorn.
Butter the outside of the bread, fill with the tuna and grated cheese, and cook in a pan for 3-4 minutes each side until golden.
recipes.tagline: Tuna, sweetcorn and melted cheese in golden, crunchy toast.

recipes.name: Homemade sausage rolls
method: Heat the oven to 200C (180C fan). Squeeze the sausage meat from the skins and mix with the herbs and grated apple.
Unroll the pastry, cut in half lengthways, lay the sausage meat along each strip and roll up. Seal, brush with beaten egg and cut into pieces.
Bake for 25 minutes until golden. Serve warm or cold with tomato and cucumber.
recipes.tagline: Flaky, golden homemade sausage rolls. Better than the bakery's.

recipes.name: Chicken and sweetcorn soup
method: Simmer the chicken and sliced ginger in the stock cube dissolved in 1.2 litres of water for 15 minutes. Lift out the chicken and shred it.
Add the sweetcorn and soy sauce. Mix the cornflour with a little water, stir in and simmer until slightly thick.
Return the chicken. Slowly pour in the beaten eggs while stirring to make silky ribbons. Serve with spring onions and bread.
recipes.tagline: Velvety chicken and sweetcorn soup, like the takeaway's but homemade.

recipes.name: Ham and cheese bagel pizzas
method: Heat the grill. Split and lightly toast the bagels.
Spread with tomato purée, sprinkle with herbs, then top with ham and mozzarella.
Grill until bubbling. Serve with sliced tomato and cucumber.
recipes.tagline: Bagel pizzas: crispy, cheesy and ready in 15 minutes.

recipes.name: Chicken pesto pasta
method: Cook the pasta. Fry the chicken pieces in the oil until cooked through.
Toss the pasta with the pesto, halved tomatoes, chicken and a splash of the pasta water. Finish with cheese.
notes: Good hot, or cold the next day in a lunchbox.
recipes.tagline: Basil pesto pasta with juicy chicken and cherry tomatoes.

recipes.name: Sausage and egg breakfast burritos
method: Squeeze the sausage meat from the skins and fry, breaking it up, until golden and cooked through.
Add the beaten eggs and stir gently until just set.
Fill the warm wraps with the sausage and egg, cheese and salsa, and roll up.
notes: Wrap in foil and freeze for grab-and-go mornings. Reheat thoroughly.
recipes.tagline: Sausage, egg and melting cheese wrapped up for breakfast on the go.

recipes.name: Fluffy pancakes with berries and honey
method: Whisk the flour, baking powder, sugar, eggs and milk into a thick batter.
Melt a little butter in a frying pan and cook ladlefuls for 2 minutes each side until golden and risen.
Warm the berries in a small pan until juicy. Stack the pancakes with yoghurt, berries and honey.
recipes.tagline: Thick, fluffy pancakes stacked high with berries and a drizzle of honey.

recipes.name: Cinnamon French toast with caramelised bananas
method: Whisk the eggs, milk and cinnamon. Dip the bread in to soak both sides.
Fry in a little butter for 2 minutes each side until golden.
Fry the sliced bananas in the pan for 1 minute, add the honey and serve over the toast.
recipes.tagline: Cinnamon-sugar French toast with caramelised bananas. A weekend treat.

recipes.name: Homemade sausage and egg breakfast muffins
method: Mix the mince with the herbs, salt and pepper and shape into 4 thin patties. Fry for 4 minutes each side until cooked through.
Fry the eggs in the oil, flattening them to fit the muffins.
Toast the muffins and stack with a patty, cheese and egg.
recipes.tagline: Homemade breakfast muffins: sausage patty, egg and cheese in a toasted muffin.

recipes.name: PB and jam overnight oats
method: Mix the oats, milk and yoghurt and split between two jars.
Swirl in the peanut butter and jam, top with berries and leave in the fridge overnight.
recipes.tagline: Peanut butter and jam oats, made the night before. Tastes like a treat.

recipes.name: Huevos rancheros
method: Crisp the tortillas in a dry pan.
Warm the drained beans with the paprika and a splash of water, roughly mashing some.
Fry the eggs in the oil. Top each tortilla with beans, eggs, salsa and grated cheese.
recipes.tagline: Eggs on crispy tortillas with spicy beans and salsa. Breakfast with a kick.

recipes.name: Sweet potato and bacon hash with eggs
method: Dice the sweet potato and fry in the oil for 10 minutes, stirring, until tender and crisp.
Add the sliced onion, chopped bacon and paprika and cook for 5 minutes until the bacon is crisp.
Make two hollows, crack in the eggs, cover and cook for 3-4 minutes until the whites are set.
recipes.tagline: Crispy sweet potato hash with bacon and runny eggs.

recipes.name: Bagels with cream cheese and crispy bacon
method: Grill or fry the bacon until crisp. Toast the bagels.
Spread with cream cheese and top with bacon and sliced tomato.
recipes.tagline: Toasted bagels with cream cheese and crispy bacon. Simple and so good.

recipes.name: Honey granola yoghurt pots
method: Heat the oven to 170C (150C fan). Mix the oats, honey, oil and seeds and spread on a tray. Bake for 15-20 minutes, stirring once, until golden. Cool.
Layer the yoghurt, berries and granola in glasses or bowls.
notes: The granola keeps in a jar for 2 weeks.
recipes.tagline: Crunchy homemade honey granola layered with yoghurt and berries.

recipes.name: Cheesy egg and spinach breakfast quesadillas
method: Scramble the eggs softly in the oil with the spinach.
Spread over half of each tortilla, add cheese and fold over.
Cook in a dry pan for 2 minutes each side until crisp and melted. Cut into wedges.
recipes.tagline: Cheesy, crispy breakfast quesadillas with egg and spinach.

recipes.name: Cheesy garlic bread
method: Heat the oven to 200C (180C fan). Mash the butter with the crushed garlic and herbs.
Split the baguette, spread with the garlic butter and top with mozzarella.
Bake for 8-10 minutes until golden and bubbling.
recipes.tagline: Hot, buttery, cheesy garlic bread. Need we say more?

recipes.name: Loaded nachos
method: Heat the oven to 200C (180C fan). Spread the tortilla chips on a tray, scatter with the drained beans and cheese.
Bake for 6-8 minutes until melted. Top with salsa, yoghurt and spring onions.
recipes.tagline: Loaded nachos with melted cheese, salsa and a dollop of yoghurt.

recipes.name: Banana chocolate oat cookies
method: Heat the oven to 180C (160C fan). Mash the bananas and mix with the oats, peanut butter, cinnamon and chopped chocolate.
Spoon 12 mounds onto a lined tray and flatten slightly.
Bake for 12-15 minutes until golden. Cool on the tray.
recipes.tagline: Soft, chewy banana and chocolate oat cookies. No mixer needed.

recipes.name: Cheese scones
method: Heat the oven to 220C (200C fan). Rub the butter into the flour, then stir in most of the cheese and the mustard.
Add the milk and bring together into a soft dough. Pat out 3cm thick and cut into 8 rounds.
Top with the rest of the cheese and bake for 12-15 minutes until risen and golden.
recipes.tagline: Warm, fluffy cheese scones. Perfect with a cuppa.

recipes.name: Berry yoghurt ice lollies
method: Blend everything until smooth.
Pour into lolly moulds or small cups with a spoon, and freeze for at least 4 hours.
recipes.tagline: Creamy fruit and yoghurt ice lollies: a cool treat with no added sugar.

recipes.name: Peanut butter banana pinwheels
method: Spread the wrap with peanut butter, lay the banana at one edge and roll up tightly.
Slice into rounds.
recipes.tagline: Banana rolled up in a peanut butter wrap and sliced into pinwheels.

recipes.name: Cinnamon sugar popcorn
method: Heat the oil in a large lidded pan, add the kernels, cover and shake over a medium heat until the popping stops.
Toss with the sugar and cinnamon while warm.
recipes.tagline: Warm popcorn with a crunchy cinnamon-sugar coating.

recipes.name: Pitta chips and hummus
method: Heat the oven to 200C (180C fan). Cut the pittas into triangles, toss with the oil and paprika and bake for 8-10 minutes until crisp.
Serve with the hummus.
recipes.tagline: Crunchy homemade pitta chips with creamy hummus.
